name: Lunit Inc.
summary: Lunit Inc. provides AI-powered software and solutions for cancer diagnostics and therapeutics in South Korea. It offers AI solution for chest X-ray and mammography, as well as AI solution for digital breast tomosynthesis, and AI-powered biomarker for immune phenotyping and PD-L1 biomarker analyzer.
